tools.name: list_route_examples
tools.description: List the built-in example routing problems. Use one to see a realistic input, or solve it as-is to show what the tool does.

tools.name: get_route_example
tools.description: Return the full input of one example, in exactly the shape optimize_routes accepts. Edit it (depot, stops, vehicles, windows) to match the user's situation.

tools.name: optimize_routes
tools.description: Plan routes for one or more vehicles from one depot and return, per vehicle, the stop order with arrival times and load so far, plus stops that could not be served, totals, Google Maps links and warnings. Uses real road driving times. Solves take 10-60 s (more when many addresses must be looked up).

tools.name: get_route_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of an optimize_routes job that returned status 'running'. Waits up to wait_seconds; call again while status is 'running'. Jobs expire 15 minutes after they finish.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "optimize_routes" is 855 chars, far longer than this server's median (168). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
